name: Mahmoud and Ehab and the even-odd game
justification: Pure parity aha; the whole solution is one if-statement.
solution_sketch: If n is even Mahmoud takes all of n and wins immediately; if n is odd he must leave an odd number (or can't move at n=1), and Ehab can always win from odd. Answer: even -> Mahmoud, odd -> Ehab.
